summary: Endeavour Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K with interim financial statements and MD&A for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, including CEO and CFO certifications. The filing shows higher revenue and a swing to profitability, but it does not announce any special-situations event such as an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or capital return. Although prior-period balances reference an assets-held-for-sale and a gain on sale of Bolanitos, those are routine historical items not tied to a current corporate action in this filing. This is a standard periodic report, not a special situation.
